headline: Clinton executive order sets guiding principles for how federal agencies plan and choose infrastructure investments.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order lays out principles that federal agencies are to follow when they spend money on infrastructure. No summary was provided, so the specific rules, requirements, and agencies covered cannot be confirmed from the source material.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that fund or build infrastructure
who_it_affects.how: They are directed to follow the order's principles when deciding on infrastructure spending.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 26, 1994; the effective date is not stated in the provided material.
